name: Jacumba Hot Springs Hotel
notes: On-site restaurant is Long Shadow (44500 Old Hwy 80, Jacumba Hot Springs), linked from the hotel's own restaurant page. Extracted from the current summer menu PDF via pdftotext -raw, covering breakfast, lunch/all-day dining mains, sides, cocktails, wine, beer, and bar bites. The PDF's raw text stream repeats a number of identical name+price blocks (evidently the same dish printed on more than one panel of a multi-page/foldout menu); duplicates were deduped by exact name+price. Cocktail/wine items with a second glass-or-bottle price are recorded as an additional '(Bottle)' line at the second price. Section labels are best-effort groupings by dish type, since the PDF's own section headers did not align cleanly with pdftotext's raw ordering.
